component.name: Claude Science Desktop
component.summary: Unofficial desktop window for Claude Science

description.p: An unofficial, community-built desktop window for Claude Science on Linux, where Anthropic ships no official desktop app. It starts the local claude-science daemon, signs you in, and renders its web UI in a native window instead of a browser tab.
Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Anthropic. "Claude" and "Claude Science" are trademarks of Anthropic PBC, used here only to describe which program this wrapper opens.
No Anthropic code is included. Claude Science is downloaded from Anthropic's own servers and verified against the checksum Anthropic publishes. Using it requires accepting Anthropic's terms.
Note: Claude Science sandboxes its agent with bubblewrap, which cannot run inside a Flatpak sandbox, so this app starts the daemon on the host.
Linux-only release; the daemon is fetched at install time.
